label: Developer Productivity Pro
summary: Advanced project workspaces with scoped shortcuts, dependency reports, environment comparisons and qualified optional development sessions. The module focuses on multi-project productivity rather than replacing baseline panel forms or file editing.
core_boundary: Core keeps shared UI components, themes/accessibility, file editing, ordinary command navigation and authorized project operations. This module adds optional project coordination; custom widgets or terminal sessions cannot create an alternate resource authority.
acceptance: Resolve every widget, environment link and action through current Core ownership and approved scoped APIs.
Qualify any optional development-session broker as a non-root isolated capability with explicit expiry/revocation policy.
Keep repository/dependency metadata and environment differences redacted and source-attributed.
Test disabled providers, stale links, revoked staff access and cross-project leakage.
Restore usable standard Core navigation and project/resource control when the module is disabled.
